I need to make a decision in Monopoly.

I'm p3 with $1160 and two properties: St. Charles Place and Pennsylvania Railroad. I'm checking the color sets of other players to assess trade opportunities.

p1 has scattered properties with no color set. p2 owns only the B&O Railroad. p4 is visiting jail with no cash or holdings. I can trade, mortgage, or end my turn.

I'm weighing trade offers. A pink monopoly would require States and Virginia, both unowned. I have little leverage to acquire them. Abandoning St. Charles Place would sacrifice that path.
